services.name: Elkhorn Slough Tour
services.desc: A wildlife tour on one of California's largest tidal waterways Duration 1 hour and 30 minutes About Join us on a one-of-a-kind, electric-powered catamaran ride for a wildlife tour along one of California's largest tidal waterways. Enjoy a narrated cruise along the Elkhorn Slough, a vibrant and lively wetland located on Highway 1 between Santa Cruz and Monterey in Moss Landing. Highlights Scan for otters, sea lions, birds, and beyond during a cruise through these peaceful waters. What's Included We have a naturalist on board to assist in wildlife spotting, providing insight into the natural wonders of the Slough and to answer any questions. There is also a bathroom on board.
